itemName: Shipping is free for order totals of at least 50 ~ Orders of 50 or more units get a 5% bulk discount
prompt:
## Task
Do A and B state the same business rule (the same policy, so that changing the policy would require changing both), even if the code is shaped differently or uses other units? Different policies that happen to share a threshold are not the same rule.

### A
rule: Shipping is free for order totals of at least 50
where: src/shipping/domain/free-shipping.ts costFor (component shipping)
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
if (orderTotal >= 50) {
=====SOURCE-END=====

### B
rule: Orders of 50 or more units get a 5% bulk discount
where: src/catalog/domain/bulk-discount.ts rateFor (component catalog)
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
if (quantity >= 50) {
=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: A quantity-based discount and a value-based shipping waiver are different policies that share the number 50.
